authors: Rosa Crovetto, Robert H. Wood, Vladimir Majer
title: Revised densities of {xCO2 + (1-x)H2O} with x < 0.014 at supercritical conditions: molar volumes, partial molar volumes of CO2 at infinite dilution, and excess molar volumes
experimental_method: Vibrating-tube densimeter: density difference between dilute aqueous CO2 and pure water at 651-726 K and 28, 33, 38 MPa; this paper corrects a computational error in the conversion of period of vibration to density in Crovetto et al. 1990.
uncertainties_stated: None stated for the Table 1 values; Table 2 gives graphical extrapolation errors.
quality_remarks: Revised data superseding Crovetto et al. J. Chem. Thermodynamics 1990, 22, 231 (authors report a computational mistake there, and that m in the earlier table was a different quantity; see footnote a). PDF page 1 is the end of another article (Svoboda and Finke, p.1138); the Crovetto paper occupies PDF pages 2-9 (journal pp.1139-1146). Two digits are blemished in the scan (Dp -83.56 at 665.40 K; Vphi 410.9 at 725.50 K), read from 400 dpi zooms and supported by internal consistency (rho + |Dp| equal within replicate pairs). Temperature scale not stated.
not_extracted_tables: Table 2: apparent molar volumes of CO2 at x=0 and x=0.01 graphically obtained from Table 1 (derived/extrapolated)
